title: Gluten-Free Bengali Poha Breakfast Balls
description: A delicious and easy-to-make breakfast recipe using poha and nuts, perfect for a gluten-free diet.
instructions: 1. In a pan, heat the ghee or oil over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped nuts and sauté until lightly browned.
3. Add the crushed poha and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the cardamom powder and mix well.
5. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
6. Add the crushed nutty balls and mix well.
7. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls.
8. Place the balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
10. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
